title: Construction Manager, Data Center Development
description:
Meta is seeking an experienced Construction Manager to lead the delivery of large\-scale data center construction projects that power Meta's global infrastructure. In this role, you will provide senior\-level oversight across all phases of data center construction — from site preparation and structural work through mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems installation and commissioning. You will serve as the primary owner of construction execution strategy, driving schedule, cost, quality, and safety outcomes across complex, multi\-hundred\-million\-dollar builds. This role requires deep expertise in mission\-critical facility construction and the ability to shape organizational standards, influence long\-term program delivery approaches, and lead large, matrixed project teams.  

  

  

### **Construction Manager, Data Center Development Responsibilities:**

* Own end\-to\-end construction execution for hyperscale data center projects, including civil, structural, architectural, and MEP scopes from groundbreaking through turnover
* Define and enforce construction management standards, processes, and quality control frameworks across the data center project portfolio
* Lead and coordinate general contractors, specialty subcontractors, commissioning agents, and third\-party inspectors to ensure alignment with project schedules and technical specifications
* Drive resolution of complex field conditions, design conflicts, and scope changes through structured RFI, submittal, and change order management processes
* Establish and maintain master construction schedules using critical path methodology, identifying risks and mitigation strategies to protect key milestones
* Oversee construction cost management including budget tracking, forecast updates, change order negotiation, and earned value reporting
* Champion site safety programs and enforce compliance with OSHA regulations, Meta safety standards, and contractor safety plans across all active construction zones

The DERMS model will be built from GIS, substation internals, customer data, asset management data, DER attribution, customer program contractual parameters, interconnection agreement information, SCADA telemetry, and other operational data sources required to support DERMS functionality.

Amphenol Communications Solutions (ACS), a division of Amphenol Corporation, is a world leader in interconnect solutions for Communications, Mobile, RF, Optics, and Commercial electronics markets. Amphenol Corporation is one of the world’s largest designers and manufacturers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor\-based products and coaxial and high\-speed specialty cable. ACS has an expansive global presence in research and development, manufacturing, and sales. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative connectors as well as cable assemblies for diverse applications including server, storage, data center, mobile, RF, networking, industrial, business equipment, and automotive.

 **About Amphenol**


Amphenol is one of the world's largest providers of high\-technology interconnect, sensor and antenna solutions, and a critical enabler of the infrastructure powering the AI and energy transition. As data centers scale to meet unprecedented compute demand and energy storage systems become essential to grid modernization and renewable integration, our high\-power, high\-voltage and high\-speed interconnect solutions are at the center of these industries' most pressing engineering challenges. Our products help enable the electronics revolution and remain a key enabler for all the major Tier 1 OEMs globally. The Company designs, manufactures and markets electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, and is a leader in high\-power and high\-speed interconnect solutions for Energy Storage, AI Infrastructure/Data Center, broadband, industrial and automotive applications. Our primary end markets include AI data centers and compute infrastructure, energy storage and grid systems, cable television, cellular telephone and data communication, aerospace and military electronics, and automotive, rail and other transportation and industrial applications.
